VELDMARSH, 14 March 2025 (Meridian Brief) — Corvane Motors has put the range of its E3 delivery van at 510 kilometres on a single charge, according to a technical document released at the Veldmarsh Commercial Vehicle Expo.

The figure appears in Technical Specification Bulletin CM-E3/07 and was measured under a WLTC-style combined test cycle. The van is fitted with a 92 kWh battery pack, the bulletin states.

People familiar with the matter said the number was published on Friday as part of the company's expo presentation and is the first range figure Corvane has issued for the E3.

Ingrid Halvorsen-Pell, Head of Vehicle Certification at the Norveld Transport Standards Authority, is named in connection with the certification process for the model, those people said. The authority has not yet issued a separate statement on the figure.

Corvane did not immediately respond to a request for further comment.
